message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the CSV data or loaded images at any point in the data acquisition flow.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local paths only (e.g., './data/train.csv', 'data/train_images'); no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication is present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only encodes labels via LabelEncoder and counts classes; there is no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tool used.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training samples anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights via `torch.load(name)` and `utility.initialize_net()` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision, leaving serialized model files unverified.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only encodes labels and counts classes but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack code anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The validation split is derived from the same dataset object as training with no separate held-out test set, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no evidence of multiple independent metrics being tracked to cross-validate results.

No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape, range, or schema validation checks on incoming data before it is passed to the model during inference; the dataset loader reads images directly without validation.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model output probabilities for NaN values, out-of-range values, or applies calibrated thresholds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision pipeline (image classification), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
